prompt: Elements `[50, 30, 20, 15, 10, 8, 16]` are placed into an array and converted into a Min-Heap using Floyd's bottom-up buildHeap algorithm. Which array representation satisfies the min-heap parent-child invariant `A[i] <= A[2i+1]` and `A[i] <= A[2i+2]`?
explanation: A valid binary min-heap must satisfy A[i] <= children for every parent. Bottom-up heapify rearranges `[50, 30, 20, 15, 10, 8, 16]` to `[8, 10, 16, 15, 30, 20, 50]`.
